mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

SELECT i.line_no,i.authorization_id,i.authorization_version,i.request_id,a.state_json AS authorization_json,r.state_json AS request_json FROM payment_batch_item i JOIN payment_authorization_revision a ON a.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND a.authorization_id=i.authorization_id AND a.version=i.authorization_version JOIN payment_execution_request_revision r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.request_id=i.request_id AND r.version=i.request_version WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY i.line_no
